entries.rationale: Semantic rename to the catalog-wide screening name. The tool screens Pendle MARKETS by chain, liquidity, implied APY, expiry window, maturity, underlying, category and flags, sorts and pages them; `yields` names one of its returned columns rather than the thing it returns. morpho.markets.discover is the same operation on the other lending protocol and the two now match, which is what makes cross-protocol routing readable to the model.

Plural and verb corrected. The tool values EVERY Pendle leg the session wallet holds on every chain, so the singular `position` was wrong, and `value` is what it returns rather than an action on a resource. Aligns with morpho__positions_get.

Verb added; one market's bounded time series, addressed by chain plus market address.
Verb added; OHLCV for ONE asset over a bounded window.

Resource group made explicit. The toolId is flat but the tool is chain+market scoped exactly like the other three market reads, and grouping it under `market_` puts the four together in a sorted namespace listing.

Resource/verb order fixed and the qualifier moved onto the noun. `merkle` is the kind of reward, not an action on rewards. `list` because the read enumerates every accrued reward token for the session wallet. Deliberately NOT named `rewards_get`, so it never reads as the counterpart of a claim: the description states Vex can never claim these (no merkle proof is published).
Segment order inverted so the noun phrase reads correctly (asset prices, not prices-of-kind-assets) and a verb added. `get` fits both call shapes: named ids, or a paged sweep of one chain.
